loopBoundary: Read-only package and threat-intel scanning, held-reason reporting, and owned learning updates. Package installs and source mutation stay gated.
autonomousActions: classify scan findings and draft held-reason summaries
update GuardDog-owned scan status and learning records
refresh cached scan evidence without changing package source
approvalRequiredActions: install, uninstall, or modify packages and hooks
send alerts, reports, or external notifications
change credentials, tokens, or provider permissions
protected flow mutation or destructive action

reflectionQuestions.prompt: How could this get even better?
What can be more automated within our safeguards?
What evidence supports the hold or allow decision?
What manual approval boundary must remain untouched?
